name: EPIC 210390334
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 13.8 solar radii and 1.76 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210390334 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.814528 (16th-84th percentiles 13.44669-14.204958), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,456 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.76 solar masses and 13.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,820 K at its surface.
